note: The OLG fully covers FNS 821.1. The 'Citizenship Overview - SNAP' page contains both the standard verification document list (Verification of Citizenship section) and the signed statement fallback (Self-Declaration of Citizenship section). The document list matches FNS closely: birth certificate, passport, naturalization papers (I-179, I-197), baptismal record, hospital birth record, military service papers, voter registration. The OLG also includes additional acceptable documents not in FNS (court records, parent citizenship derivation, TAFDC cross-verification). The signed statement fallback mirrors FNS requirements: (1) available only when standard documents cannot be obtained with a reasonable explanation, (2) must be from a U.S. citizen, (3) declares under penalty of perjury that the member is a U.S. citizen, and (4) must contain a warning of penalties for helping someone commit fraud. The only minor omission is that FNS specifies 'Indian census records' as a standard document and the OLG does not list this explicitly, though the OLG does address American Indian citizenship separately. Layer 1 missed the Self-Declaration section because it was in a separate chunk from the document list.
